acceptance: NO_AUTO_PROMOTION; robustness require net2>0/PF>1, DD and streak lower, AND no negative 10/2026 window OR winner top2 concentration failure, H4 placebo and H5 concentration, actual costs/time/funding, new untouched OOS

cost_contract.DD: realized exit-leg cohort sums, with new reverse leg booked only at actual future terminal, never instant recovery
cost_contract.baseline: native saved modeled round trip cost ×2; normalized one-third portfolio units for all candidates
cost_contract.close_at: candle close after market bar complete; next-open for decision-derived bail/reentry
cost_contract.extension_carry: model only, not actual historical signed funding
cost_contract.gap: stop-first and worst of open/stop fill

stages.mode: merged positions only, corrected fill/stop geometry, no duplicate signals, native published stop/48h time close

stages.condition: native TIMEOUT at completed 48th 1h close, +1.0 original stop-price-R, close>EMA20 and EMA20 slope rising
stages.extra_funding_model: 5 instrument bps per commenced8h hold, plus original native realized cost, with multiplier 2 model
stages.floor: max(sealed SL, entry+0.5R, previous completed high-water−1.25R); stop-first; gap worse at open

stages.condition: while original long still live AND native stop not touched, after >=2 completed bars close below EMA20, EMA20 slope negative, current close<previous close and price <= entry−0.5 initial stop-R; liquidate at next real 1h open
stages.exit_cost: retain original native already-modeled fee/funding even on shorter hold
stages.source_clock: signal only after completed previous bar; no same-bar exit at previous close

stages.condition: only after a realized negative long from native stop or S2 abort; the LAST fully completed bar close<prior close and both last closes below EMA20 with EMA20 declining; next 1h open only
stages.risk: at most same original 1/3 normalized size, never adding to a losing long, no DCA, no leverage increase; one short per long loss
stages.short_model_cost: max(source long native instrument cost,14bps) ×1/3, stress doubled, plus 5 instrument bps per commenced8h hold ×1/3; no observed historical short funding
stages.short_stop: max(last2 completed highs+0.25ATR14, short_entry+1.5ATR14) from completed bars only
stages.short_trailing: once prior completed bar has +1R excursion, next-bar stop floor short min(native stop, short_entry−0.25R, prior completed lowest low+1.25R), never same-bar lookahead

stages.condition: if three prior COMPLETED opportunity outcomes are negative at stress2x and closed in 36h then block new entries for 6h after third loss; no post-result trade labels
stages.power: do NOT retroactively remove losing trades; count skipped original winners and losers
stages.suspension: time stop new admissions only, never interrupt active positions; no forced 0-streak claims

unified_signal_owner.delayed_min_stop: LONG only, native sealed SL < actual delayed entry (stop>=entry source invalid, exclude as ENTRY_GEOMETRY_FAIL; preserve raw count)
unified_signal_owner.fixed_size: each admitted original intent 1/3 instrument notional risk scaling, Liquid6 already 1/3, Delayed normalized from 1.0 to 1/3
unified_signal_owner.no_new_signals: all potential opportunities from union of existing saved completed parent receipts only; never synthesize missing new signals from freed capacity
unified_signal_owner.optional_risk_factor: only Stage4 streak exposure pause, no variable martingale
unified_signal_owner.owner_guard: per-symbol one position at a time incl cooling off 2h after terminal; among simultaneous different symbols alphabetical; max 6 open 1/3 units (2 gross risk units)
unified_signal_owner.priority: Liquid6 first confirmation owner when both exist; otherwise Delayed Fill as residual, NEVER both
